# Code of Conduct

This workshop is a learning space. Be respectful, patient, and constructive.

## Expected behavior

- Help others without taking over their keyboard.
- Assume good intent and explain acronyms or shortcuts.
- Respect different experience levels, tools, and accessibility needs.
- Keep feedback specific to the work.
- Protect private information and never ask others to share secrets.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discriminatory language, intimidation, unwanted attention, disclosure of private information, or disruption of the workshop are not acceptable.

## Reporting

Tell a facilitator or repository maintainer if you see or experience a problem. Facilitators may pause an activity, separate participants, or remove someone from the workshop to keep the environment safe.
